## Steps

<figure class="story-hero"><a href="/forge-studio/media/stories/proof/01-open-studio-on-the-projects-pillar.png"><img src="/forge-studio/media/stories/proof/01-open-studio-on-the-projects-pillar.png" alt="1. Open Studio on the Projects pillar"></a></figure>

1. **Open Studio on the Projects pillar.** The Projects pillar lists every project forge manages.
2. **Click the card for a project this repository carries.** The card is a real link to that project’s own page — the route is the project the previous beat found, not one written down in advance.
3. **Go back to the Projects pillar.** The Projects pillar is one click away from anywhere in Studio.
4. **Click "Onboard a project".** Onboarding asks for the few things a Factory needs before it can build a repo: what to call it, the quality gate that judges its work, and the north star that tells a planner what it is for.
5. **Fill in the name, the quality gate and the north star — and under Advanced, the repo path — then press "Onboard project →".** Registering the project lands the operator on its page.
